degradation_pattern: Pervasive, high-frequency luminance noise characterized by dense, granular, or speckle textures that significantly obscure fine details and reduce overall surface smoothness and clarity across the entire visual field.

Subtle, fine-grained luminance noise creating a soft or slight grainy texture that minimally obscures underlying details, particularly affecting mid-tones, shadows, or darker regions with low spatial correlation and minimal chromatic interference.
A subtle, fine-grained luminance noise that creates slight graininess particularly noticeable in the mid-tones without significantly obscuring details, maintaining overall image clarity.
